sources.name: Pennsylvania DCNR Lehigh Gorge State Park access directions and GPS
observations: DCNR identifies White Haven as the northern access area and publishes White Haven South Access Area GPS 41.055270,-75.771581.
DCNR distinguishes the South Access Area from the White Haven North Access Area, whose published GPS coordinate is 41.062944,-75.773107.
sources.limits: This is an access-area GPS coordinate, not a separately surveyed shoreline or hand-launch toe.

sources.name: Pennsylvania DCNR Whitewater Boating at Lehigh Gorge State Park
observations: DCNR lists White Haven to Rockport as 8.7 miles and White Haven to Glen Onoko as 20.9 miles.
DCNR states that boaters must use designated access areas and that launches and take-outs occur only at Department-designated areas.
sources.limits: The page establishes the route and launch-area rules but does not publish a coordinate for the exact wet toe.

sources.name: Pennsylvania DCNR Lehigh Gorge State Park recreational guide map
observations: The official guide identifies a hand-carry boat-launch map symbol and describes White Haven as an access area; the map's GPS table lists the matching South Access Area coordinate.
The map lists the three Lehigh Gorge trip lengths and labels White Haven, Rockport, and Glen Onoko access areas.
sources.limits: The map symbol establishes a launch in the access area but is not georeferenced finely enough to identify a shoreline toe.

decision: Retain the exact DCNR White Haven South Access coordinate as an authoritative access-area anchor. The matched river flowline is about 305 feet away and mapped water about 229 feet away; this supports a review label and investigation of site-versus-toe precision, not an unsupported coordinate move.
